title: Text units and vocabulary IDs
description: A quick reference for the text representations and tokenizer terms used in this chapter.

terms.definition: One byte of UTF-8-encoded text; one visible text symbol may occupy several bytes.
A Unicode code-point value treated as one input position by this chapter's scalar-level tokenizer.
A fixed lookup table that assigns known text units deterministic integer IDs.
The integer representing a text unit at one sequence position and later selecting an embedding row.
A reserved marker used when a text unit is absent from the vocabulary, losing the original unit's identity.
Encoding followed by decoding that recovers the original text when every input unit is known.
A user-perceived character that may contain more than one Unicode scalar value.
A tokenizer using units between whole words and individual characters to balance vocabulary size and sequence length.
